title.ko: 콩고 기본법 — 과도기 공권력 조직에 관하여 (1991년 6월 4일)
title.en: Fundamental Act of the Congo on the Organisation of Public Powers during the Transition (4 June 1991)

description.ko: 브라자빌의 주권 국민회의가 채택한 과도기 헌법. 전문은 일당제 아래의 전체주의·족벌주의·부족주의와 정치적 처형을 단죄하고, 본문은 국호를 콩고 공화국으로 되돌리며 집행권을 국민회의가 뽑은 총리에게, 입법권을 공화국 최고평의회에 넘긴다.
description.en: The transitional constitution adopted by the Sovereign National Conference in Brazzaville. Its preamble condemns the totalitarianism, nepotism, tribalism and political executions of single-party rule; its articles restore the name Republic of the Congo, hand executive power to a prime minister elected by the conference and legislative power to the Higher Council of the Republic.

source: Acte fondamental portant organisation des pouvoirs publics durant la période de transition (4 juin 1991), Journal officiel de la République du Congo, édition spéciale, juin 1991, Brazzaville. Text: Digithèque MJP (Jean-Pierre Maury, Université de Perpignan), https://mjp.univ-perp.fr/constit/cg1991.htm (accessed 2026-10-07). Constitutional act of a state body; not subject to copyright.
